title: Galloping Horse with Hand-Painted Border
description: Hand painted in acrylic. Layers of texture bring life and fun to this original, and the decorative hand-painted border means you can hang it straight on your wall, or combine it with a frame for a fun layered look.

images.alt: Galloping Horse by Calico Melton: a brown horse with a patterned saddle cloth on a pale pink ground, inside a hand-painted blue and yellow border.
